tools.description: List current legislators, filterable by state, chamber, party, or name.

tools.name: get_regulation
tools.description: One regulation with full detail (abstract, agencies, comment deadline, Federal Register link) and its related bills.

tools.name: recent_changes

tools.name: get_bill_changes
tools.description: One bill's detected change history (actions, status, sponsors), newest first.

tools.name: bill_timeline
tools.description: A bill's full dated history from Docket Room's records, newest first: every official action, the status changes and amendments the nightly detected, text versions and hearings, with the events that moved the bill flagged material=true. Free plans see the latest 3 events.

tools.name: verify_quote
tools.description: Check whether exact language appears in a bill's text, and where. Returns the passage as printed, its section, which text version was checked and whether that is the final (enrolled) version — or, when it isn't there, the closest passage and how similar it is. Use before quoting a bill to a client.

tools.description: What changed on the bills the signed-in user tracks — the personal monitoring digest. Requires an OAuth connection.

tools.name: whats_new
tools.description: The morning check: what changed on the signed-in user's tracked bills and keyword alerts since they last called whats_new, plus hearings on tracked bills in the next 7 days. Docket Room remembers when you last asked, so the user never has to say 'since when'. Requires an OAuth connection.

tools.name: set_alerts
tools.description: View or change the signed-in user's alert settings: the email digest (on/off, daily or weekly, hour and time zone), hearing alerts and their lead time, status-change alerts, and how often each tracked bill or keyword alert notifies. Docket Room checks bills nightly, so alerts arrive in the digest, n

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: The team's outbound webhook subscriptions: each receives one HMAC-signed batch of matching bill changes after the nightly ingest (empty batches are never sent). Delivery health (last status, consecutive failures, auto-disable) is included.

The signing secret is returned ONCE — store it. A test ping fires immediately and

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.description: Delete one of the team's webhook subscriptions (by id from list_webhooks). This is the reversal path for webhook delivery — no further batches are sent. Confirm with the user before deleting.

tools.name: get_organization_profile
tools.description: The team's organization profile (industry, products, jurisdictions, activities, priorities) — the context assess_bill_impact and scan_relevant_bills personalize against.

tools.name: set_organization_profile
tools.description: Create or update the team's organization profile. Provided fields are updated; omitted fields keep their current value. The richer the profile, the better relevance and impact assessments get.

tools.name: assess_bill_impact
tools.description: Assess a bill against the team's organization profile: is it relevant, why, which operations it touches, legal/financial/operational/reputational severity, concrete compliance obligations (quote-verified against the bill text), and recommended questions for legal/policy review. First call generates

tools.name: scan_relevant_bills

tools.name: set_team_bill_record
tools.description: Create or update the TEAM's working record on a bill (kept strictly separate from official legislative facts and from personal tracking): owner, organizational position (support/oppose/support_with_amendment/neutral/watch — SHARED with the team's app workspace, including its Slack notifications), pr

tools.name: add_team_bill_note
tools.description: Append an internal note to the TEAM's record on a bill (notes are append-only, shared with the team's app workspace, and never mixed with official legislative facts). Confirm with the user before posting on their behalf.

tools.name: get_team_bill_record
tools.description: The TEAM's working record on a bill — organizational position (shared with the app workspace), owner, priority, internal status, recommended actions — plus its append-only notes and the audit history of record changes (#107). Internal context only; official legislative facts come from get_bill.

tools.name: list_team_bill_records
tools.description: All bills the TEAM keeps a working record or organizational position on, most recently updated first — the team's shared docket (same state the app workspace shows). Filter by position or owner substring.

tools.name: set_bill_relevance
tools.description: Record the team's HUMAN verdict on a bill's relevance — it overrides the model: 'not_relevant' bills stop appearing in scan_relevant_bills and the override is echoed on assess_bill_impact; 'relevant' confirms and annotates. Pass clear=true to remove the override and let the model judge again.

tools.name: track_bill
tools.description: Track a bill for the signed-in user (adds it to their Docket Room tracked list, enabling change alerts). Requires an OAuth connection — team API keys carry no user identity.

tools.name: untrack_bill
tools.description: Stop tracking a bill for the signed-in user. Requires an OAuth connection. Confirm with the user before untracking.

tools.name: update_tracked_bill
tools.description: Set the signed-in user's organizational position and/or priority on a bill they track. Requires an OAuth connection.

tools.name: list_keyword_alerts
tools.description: The signed-in user's keyword/issue monitors (each scans new legislative activity and alerts on matches). Requires an OAuth connection.

tools.name: create_keyword_alert
tools.description: Create a keyword/issue monitor for the signed-in user: new bills and activity matching the keyword trigger alerts (issue-based monitoring across jurisdictions). Requires an OAuth connection.

tools.name: delete_keyword_alert
tools.description: Delete one of the signed-in user's keyword monitors (by id from list_keyword_alerts). Requires an OAuth connection. Confirm with the user before deleting.

tools.name: list_tracked_bills
tools.description: List the bills the signed-in user tracks, most recently tracked first. Requires an OAuth connection.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_bills, get_legislator, get_hearing, search_regulations, get_regulation, set_alerts, list_keyword_alerts · Private data: search_bills, get_bill, get_legislator, bill_timeline, create_webhook, set_team_bill_record, add_team_bill_note, get_team_bill_record, list_team_bill_records, set_bill_relevance, track_bill · Public sink: semantic_search_bills, set_alerts, list_webhooks, create_webhook, delete_webhook · Destructive: generate_report, delete_webhook, set_bill_relevance, delete_keyword_alert.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_bills, get_legislator, get_hearing, search_regulations, get_regulation, set_alerts, list_keyword_alerts · Private data: search_bills, get_bill, get_legislator, bill_timeline, create_webhook, set_team_bill_record, add_team_bill_note, get_team_bill_record, list_team_bill_records, set_bill_relevance, track_bill · Public sink: semantic_search_bills, set_alerts, list_webhooks, create_webhook, delete_webhook · Destructive: generate_report, delete_webhook, set_bill_relevance, delete_keyword_alert

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
